found_by: whole-suite run observation 2026-10-11, diagnosed from code
summary: createCliTransport's finally called rmSync(ephemeral) with no try/catch. On Windows a descendant still exiting after the deadline tree-kill can hold the directory, rmSync throws EPERM, and that exception replaces the pending 'CLI process timed out' rejection (or a successful result). Callers see a wrong error class; router.complete records the EPERM message (which embeds the temp path) in the job ledger and AllProvidersFailedError, and a masked SUCCESS would fall through to the next, possibly paid, provider. The temp dir is left behind.
repro: createCliTransport({timeoutMs:300,cleanup:{remove(){throw Object.assign(new Error('EPERM'),{code:'EPERM'})}}})(cli job that hangs) must reject /timed out/; before the fix (bare rmSync) the rejection was the EPERM error. Observed once in a whole-suite run; not reproduced in 3 isolated runs.
fix_direction: cleanup never replaces the primary outcome; bounded retry then swallow; report code only.

summary: Production wires no cleanup.onFailure, so a temp dir that survives all 4 removal attempts is left in os.tmpdir() silently and nothing sweeps lkb-cli-* dirs. The dir is created empty by this code; only the CLI child could put data in it, so exposure is low. Listed by the maker as an open limit but was not in the ledger.
fix_direction: wire a code-only log hook in the composition root and/or sweep stale lkb-cli-* dirs at startup. Ledger only; not a pulled unit.
